title: POST maintenance/facets
description: Rebuilds ps_facetedsearch indexes of products by id in portions with continue (the same body with the answer's cursor); 403 capability_disabled without the module (Spec §6.30). The products are those of product_ids, else those directly in category_ids, else every product of the paired shop. prices: layered_price_index; attributes: layered_product_attribute (new features and groups become indexable first); categories and all: both. The storefront's cached filter blocks are cleared when the walk ends.
